scope: Canonical typed relationship graph for 33 active scientific repositories, reorganized around theory-world / real-world interfaces. Evidence ownership remains repository-local.

relation_types.handoff: later project starts from a bounded object/question/receipt left by earlier project
relation_types.epistemic: ordered scientific questions without automatic evidence transfer
relation_types.abstraction: a specific problem/object is lifted to a more general theory/method
relation_types.provenance: developmental ancestry/origin, not current conceptual hierarchy
relation_types.complement: projects solve complementary parts of a larger task
relation_types.component: parallel companion supplies one declared obligation to a synthesis hub
relation_types.information_flow: bounded scientific/operational object passes in the stated direction
relation_types.shared_substrate: same taxon/archive/data/system under different frozen contracts
relation_types.operationalization: a theoretical distinction is instantiated in a physical/empirical design
relation_types.empirical_projection: a theory-motivated object is tested as an empirical measurement/gate without claiming validation of the source theory
relation_types.field_return: a design/search object returns to primary-data collection

vertical_programmes.surface: present phenotype -> public evolutionary history -> own-data discrimination
WHEN/WHERE -> conditional response WHY -> focal phenotype axes
SHARED COORDINATE -> MIDDLE WORLD -> DIFFERENTIATED COORDINATES
vertical_programmes.firewall: PAYOFF is a population-game lift, not Chapter 4.

vertical_programmes.surface: finite eco-genetic state -> relational future-state / warning validity

reality_programmes.surface: PRIMARY FLOWER-VISITOR RECORD -> PHYSICAL OBSERVER DIAGNOSIS

theory_constellations.surface: MISSING SUPPORT / RETAINED REFINEMENT / SEMANTIC PRESERVATION -> IDENTIFICATION BOUNDARY -> NEXT OBSERVATION

relations.meaning: non-entered support creates an identification ceiling
retained side information can contract compatible worlds
preserved observation semantics determine which distinctions survive
remaining equivalence/identified set -> next observation design

theory_constellations.firewall: REC, V3 and TNOA are sibling information operations, not a mandatory literal sequence.

theory_reality_contacts.meaning: target-facing process-preserving semantics -> flower-visitor recording design
future-relevant-state idea -> independent natural-data adequacy gates; not validation of the finite model
empirical measurement/representation adequacy before reportability licensing
biological sampling need -> bounded search geography
candidate patch -> field verification / primary-data intake
specific mechanism-allocation ambiguity -> general identification boundary

cross_program_relations.meaning: Honshu-Izu functional interaction data under different frozen questions
WHAT to measure <-> WHERE to look

development_history_not_current_hierarch: PolliPi/InsePi historically motivated TNOA/V3 questions, but are currently physical applications/testbeds beneath the general observation theory.
TNOA historically preceded REC, but REC is conceptually upstream with respect to record entry.
V3 is not a fixed stage between REC and TNOA; it is a refinement operator wherever retained side information exists before irreversible loss/coarsening.

ecosystem_system.surface: REALITY <-> OBSERVATION <-> DISTINCTIONS <-> IDENTIFICATION <-> DESIGN <-> REALITY

lens_only_no_edge.difference: missing support != retained refinement != semantic preservation
WHAT to measure != WHERE to look
finite-model state result != natural-data state/proxy adequacy
